name: Offline artifact provenance template (DEP-07)
description: Repository-only provenance template for the Phase 11 deployment foundations. SLSA level is 0, signing is false, and every commit, builder, lockfile digest, SBOM digest and test-evidence field is a PENDING placeholder until the owner records a real build. No build was recorded, no artifact is signed, and no external attestation exists.

testEvidence.role: release state machine + rollback negative controls

signing.note: No artifact is signed. The signing service and any external attestation are PENDING owner verification; the repository claims SLSA level 0 only.

slsa.note: SLSA level 0. No build provenance, no SLSA attestation and no signature is claimed by this repository-only template.
